chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Washshāʾ, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Fuḍayl ibn Yasār, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
My father wore the armor of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, Dhāt al-Fuḍūl, and it trailed along the ground; and I wore it, and it was surplus on me.

key_terms.ذَاتَ الْفُضُولِ: the name of the Prophet’s armor
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.فَخَطَّتْ: it dragged or trailed along the ground
key_terms.فَفَضَلَتْ: it remained loose or larger than needed

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith about Dhāt al-Fuḍūl show about the weapons of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله being with the Imams عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Imam inherited the armor of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and describes how it fit his father and himself. It highlights the transmission of the Prophet’s possessions among the Imams عليهم السلام and serves as a sign of their connection to the Prophetic legacy.
